title: Crunchr
shortDescription: Make 11 sounds for your game in your browser. Pick one, change it, then download one sound file or ten versions. Free, no sign-up.

pricing.note: MIT licensed and free to play. itch can take donations, but the game stays free either way.

refundPolicy: Nothing to refund: the game is free.

screenshots.caption: The whole tool: eleven sounds in four groups, seven controls, and a picture of the wave.
Shape a footstep and hear it right away. The sliders change the same sound that gets downloaded.
Ten versions, one selected. Play the set, hear one on its own, or save a single WAV.
The built-in guide, with the keyboard shortcuts.
The phone layout: one column, big controls, same sounds.
